intention: The /vehicle-stats page shows km per gallon, so the car's cost can be compared with a gasoline car in the unit Colombians actually use.
request: MAG-96 — Show gasoline equivalent (km per gallon) on the vehicle stats page. A new internal/reference module holds the monthly gasoline price; the gateway turns each month's charging cost into gallons of money at that month's price and prints SUM(distance) / SUM(gallons) as an eighth tile.

decisions.decision: Run MAG-96 as a 2-tier RM roadmap, not one CH change.
decisions.why: Spans internal/reference and internal/gateway. config.yaml mandates a roadmap for multi-module work, and a worker may only write inside one module.

decisions.decision: Read port takes a window (PricesForMonths), not one month.
decisions.why: The page asks for up to 12 months. A per-month signature means 12 round trips per render, against a read-heavy profile. Roadmap Decision D7.

decisions.decision: A month with zero charging cost is excluded from both sums.
decisions.why: The three cost columns default to 0, so an unsynced month would add real km against zero gallons and report too good a figure. Roadmap Decision D9.

decisions.decision: No currency check between the month row and the price row.
decisions.why: Both are COP today and the month column is NOT NULL DEFAULT 'COP'. User accepted that a second currency would give a wrong figure silently. Roadmap Decision D10.

decisions.decision: Tile is the eighth entry in the existing summary card, not a new card.
decisions.why: VehicleStatsTiles already holds seven formatted KPI values; reusing ui.StatTile gives the worker seven examples to mirror. Roadmap Decision D12.

decisions.decision: No default gasoline price; reuse only the newest-row-at-or-before lookup.
decisions.why: The ticket's packCapacityKWh reference is loose — that function falls back to a hardcoded 62.0. The ticket's own Catches section says hide the tile instead. Roadmap Decision D8.

decisions.decision: Seed two rows: 2026-08 = 16000 COP, 2026-09 = 16331 COP, each its own migration (task 1.5 added).
decisions.why: User set August to 16000. UNIQUE (period) allows one row per month, so 16331 moves to September.

tiers.notes: New module. reference.fuel_prices table + month-start CHECK, seeds 2026-08 = 16000 COP and 2026-09 = 16331 COP, PricesForMonths window read port, sqlc, MIGRATION_MODULES, module and root docs.
Eighth tile in the summary card. Ratio-of-sums in the view model from analytics.MonthlyReader plus the reference port. ES+EN catalogue entries, KB update.
